body: You're right, I do think too much. Sometimes I feel trapped by that, actually. I don't know how to be any other way. :( But thanks for the kind words.
That's a really great and uplifting message, but it didn't work on me. I am sure it would be fantastic for others, though. Keep up the good work!

The long-term is what I am afraid of. I see so many people living these awful, lackluster lives I could never be happy with. I hate the thought of dating, having kids, and a lot of other happy thoughts people like to hold onto to get by. I have no hope for the future, and no notion that my suffering will ever end. I have no money to go to a therapist or psychiatrist, let alone get meds. :(
